title: FuncCode: Compressing Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Function Space with Hardware-Aware Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2609.26067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace scalar edge weights with learnable univariate functions, increasing flexibility but also parameter memory because each edge stores multiple coefficients, often together with a separate base branch. We introduce FuncCode, a basis-agnostic compression approach that forms shared codebooks from sampled edge responses, codes the basis and base branches independently, and exports the resulting codebooks and per-edge indices in a quantized, bit-packed format. Across spline and polynomial KANs, sampled edge responses exhibit $13$--$35\%$ lower effective rank than their coefficient representations. Further replicated controls show that function-space clustering alone is statistically tied with coefficient-space clustering; the consistent accuracy gain comes from preserving the distinct sharing structure of the two branches. On a ten-seed MNIST benchmark, FuncCode compresses spline and GRAM KANs by $31.6\

translated_title: FuncCode：基于硬件感知量化的函数空间Kolmogorov-Arnold网络压缩方法
translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）用可学习的一元函数替代标量边权重，提高了模型灵活性，但也增加了参数内存开销，因为每条边需要存储多个系数，通常还伴随一个独立的基础分支。我们提出FuncCode，一种与基函数无关的压缩方法，它从采样的边缘响应构建共享码本，对基函数分支和基础分支进行独立编码，并以量化、位打包的格式导出所得码本及每条边的索引。在样条和多项式KAN中，采样的边缘响应相比其系数表示表现出低13%至35%的有效秩。进一步的重复对照实验表明，仅函数空间聚类与系数空间聚类在统计上效果相当；持续的精度提升来自于保留两个分支各自不同的共享结构。在十种子的MNIST基准测试中，FuncCode将样条和GRAM KAN压缩了31.6%（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: FuncCode提出了一种与基函数无关的KAN压缩方法，通过在函数空间从采样边缘响应构建共享码本、独立编码基函数与基础分支并采用硬件感知的量化位打包格式，在保留精度和分支共享结构的同时显著压缩KAN的参数内存。
en_tdlr: FuncCode is a basis-agnostic compression method for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks that builds shared codebooks from sampled edge responses in function space, encodes basis and base branches independently, and uses hardware-aware quantized bit-packed export to achieve significant memory compression while preserving accuracy.
